services.name: Wall Tent Camping
services.desc: A Cozy Getaway in North Creek 3 pm check-in, 10 am checkout About Step your camping game up a notch in one of our 14 x 16 canvas wall tents! Our classic wall tents are furnished with everything you need for a peaceful night’s sleep under the Adirondack stars. Nestled into the woods behind our Hudson River Base, each wall tent comes standard with one memory foam queen bed, one set of twin bunk beds, and plenty of sheets, pillows, and comforters to keep you cozy during your stay. If you’re looking for the Adirondack wilderness experience without sacrificing comfort, Beaver Brook’s wall All ages • Up to 4 Guests per tent • Enjoy the wilderness without sacrificing comfort

services.name: The Hudson River Gorge Rafting Trip
services.desc: 6-7 hours. We meet at 9 am and wrap up between 3 and 4. The exact end time can vary depending on water levels, give us a call for an estimate. About Rated as one of the top ten whitewater rafting trips in the U.S., the Hudson River Gorge is the pinnacle of New York whitewater rafting. 17 miles of whitewater combined with spectacular scenery will provide you with memories to last a lifetime. This is a full-day trip that has it all – big rapids, swimming, rock jumping, excellent food, and reliable dam-released water. This action-packed whitewater rafting trip is a 3-4 hour drive from Ages 8+ • 6-7 Hours • Includes Lunch • Trips on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, Sundays

services.name: Kayak & Canoe Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing day on the water! Pick up a boat from our base and take it wherever you like! Choose between single kayaks or canoes. We don't recommend more than 3 people in a canoe. Please note that we're not on the water, this is a rental to take off-site on your own adventure. We're happy to give you recommendations on where to paddle. Rental All day! If you'd like to keep the boat past our closing hours that's fine, we'll show you where to stash it. Rentals Include Boats PFDs (life jackets) Paddles Tie-down straps Suggestions on where to go if you want them! Vehicle Single Kayaks • Canoes • Full-Day Rental for Off-Site Use

services.name: Guided Tubing Trip
services.desc: s in North Creek Roughly 2.5 hours, exact end time varies depending on water levels. About Join us for guided tubing trips on the Middle Hudson. This lazy river trip takes about two hours including check-in and shuttling. Expect to be on the water about 1.5 - 2 hours. This trip is best for groups who just want to show up and have the details taken care of. Please note there is no alcohol allowed on guided trips. What's Included: A tube A Personal Floatation Device Guide All necessary shuttles How does tubing work? Show up at our whitewater base in North Creek at Includes Shuttles • 2.5 Hour Trip • Must weigh at least 50lbs • All Ages!

services.name: Tube Rentals
services.desc: Tubes to take off-site on your own adventure All-day rental About Rent a tube to take on the adventure of your choice! This option is best for people who want an unguided trip and have at least two vehicles to set up a shuttle. We’re happy to help you decide the best place to take the tubes and give you directions. If you'd like help with shuttles, check out our guided tubing trip instead! What's Included: Tubes PFDs Straps to attach the tube to your vehicle When can I rent a tube? Seven days a week 8-4. You’re welcome to keep the tube past closing, we’ll show you where to leave them Off-Site Rental • Doesn't Include Shuttling • Perfect for Your Own Adventure
